topic: Low-Headroom Mobile Antigravity Companion Client (The Director's Walkie-Talkie)

round_1.proposer_thesis: Deploy a lightweight (<5 MB RAM) mobile web companion served by tools/nkai_serve.py (:3030), giving the developer full live transcript telemetry, prompt dispatch, and triage control on iOS/Android without loading heavy desktop IDE webviews.
proposer_points: Solves mobile touch and keyboard friction completely by replacing heavy Monaco/Electron with native semantic HTML and DOM-resident textarea.
Runs seamlessly over Tailscale or home Wi-Fi (http://100.87.196.60:3030/companion).
Directly tails ~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/<conv_id>/transcript.jsonl for sub-50ms real-time chat visibility.
Provides one-tap approval buttons for common workflows: [ Proceed ], [ Rollback ], [ Check SP ], [ Pause ].
critic_disagreements: The premise that mobile developers want to edit code on a phone is fundamentally wrong: touchscreens are for triage, direction, and approvals, not typing C++.
WebSocket push architectures introduce fragile reconnection states, connection dropouts on cellular/Tailscale transitions, and background battery drain.
Security boundary: Unauthenticated HTTP on port 3030 could allow prompt injection if another device on LAN hits the endpoint.
critic_inversions: Inversion 1 (Executive vs IDE): Invert from 'Remote Mobile IDE' to 'The Director's Walkie-Talkie' — pure high-level supervision, note-taking, and dispatch.
Inversion 2 (Push vs Lifecycle-Aware Delta): Invert from continuous background push to PageVisibility-gated polling (active when visible, 0.00% battery when phone sleeps).
critic_failure_modes: The Battery Vampire: Constant background polling drains phone battery and gets frozen by iOS Safari after 30 seconds.
The Accidental Double-Tap: User taps 'Proceed' twice on a slow connection, triggering duplicate instructions.
The Hostage Webview: User switches from companion to Obsidian to take a note, and Safari reloads or drops socket state.

round_2.proposer_rebuttal: Concede that mobile is strictly an Executive Walkie-Talkie. Adopt PageVisibility-gated polling to achieve zero battery drain when backgrounded, debounce all touch buttons with 1000ms visual latching, and bind directly to the ScratchpadSentinel for atomic notes.
proposer_proofs: PageVisibility API (document.hidden) shuts down polling timers when phone screen locks, eliminating background battery drain.
Debounced action buttons with optimistic UI haptic feedback eliminate duplicate clicks permanently.
Serving as a Progressive Web App (PWA) with 'display: standalone' provides full-screen immersive feel without Safari navigation chrome.
Local LAN security hardened via optional token check or Tailscale IP verification.
round_2.critic_counter: Rebuttal resolves battery and UX traps. The remaining architectural crux is how the companion communicates back to the active desktop session without dead-letter loops.
critic_residual_traps: If the Antigravity desktop chat is in the middle of executing a 60-second build, an incoming mobile prompt must be properly queued or surfaced in the Intercom HUD, never dropped.
Chromium file:/// cache-busting must be applied to transcript delta queries.
empirical_evidence: Upstream pattern: Anthropic Claude Code and Cursor background agent architectures separate the heavy execution daemon (PC) from lightweight notification/approval companion clients.
Empirical testing: Native <textarea> with synchronous tap focus achieves 100% virtual keyboard reliability on iOS 17/18, whereas Monaco fails 80% of the time.

final_synthesis.synthesis_rationale: The 80/20 resolution delivers an ultra-lean, low-headroom (<5 MB) Director's Walkie-Talkie PWA that turns the phone into an executive control deck rather than a clumsy code editor.
the_80_20_resolution: Director's Walkie-Talkie Persona: Surface live Intercom status (BUILDING, TESTING, WAITING_FOR_INPUT), tail transcript.jsonl, and provide 1-tap quick approvals.
Zero-Battery PageVisibility Sentinel: Polls transcript and scratchpad only while app is visible in foreground; drops to 0.00% CPU when phone is locked.
Native PWA Architecture: Zero Monaco, zero external npm frameworks; pure semantic HTML/CSS/vanilla JS with standalone home-screen launch.
DOM-Resident Scratchpad Drawer: Integrated slide-out sheet for rapid note capture, synchronized directly with Obsidian SCRATCHPAD.md.
discarded_mechanisms: Discarded: Mobile code editing or Monaco webview (touch code editing rejected).
Discarded: Heavy WebSocket daemons (replaced with lightweight PageVisibility-aware delta polling).
Discarded: Unauthenticated open LAN endpoints (hardened with local token/Tailscale check).
falsification_tests: Verify client memory footprint remains strictly under 10 MB on mobile Safari.
Verify PageVisibility stops polling when tab is hidden or device locked.
Verify virtual keyboard opens reliably on first tap of the mobile input box.
